query:
One group member made a point of requesting that the exact trip dates be confirmed before the end of the week, expressing a need to check their calendar before fully committing. Which member made this specific request?

Options:
A. Priya
B. Dev
C. Simone
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T17:54:00) In, assuming I can confirm by end of week. Just to flag, I'd need the exact dates locked down so I can check my calendar properly. Can we confirm Friday at the latest?
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t0 @2025-10-05T18:41:00) I'm in if it doesn't clash with the thing. Friday should be ok but I'll confirm Weds 👍
[3] (about=Simone, episodic, t0 @2025-10-05T18:46:00) So: Italian on Friday, confirm by Wednesday. I'll take that as agreed unless I hear otherwise.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:22:00) I'm in for the 7th if it doesn't clash with the thing. the 13th for trivia I'll confirm this week
[5] (about=Dev, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T17:47:00) Which weekend.
[6] (about=Simone, episodic, t4 @2025-10-19T19:33:00) Saturday the 25th works. Just to flag, somewhere quiet would be ideal. I'd rather be able to debrief properly than sit in a place where everyone is shouting.
[7] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:42:00) Three weeks. I told Priya the same day I signed but I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here. It felt wrong to tell the group before I'd made it official.
[8] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-10-26T18:11:00) ok right trip logistics because I genuinely need to sort the train. Marcus did you book the bunkhouse? like actually book it or 'I'll do it Monday' book it
[9] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:01:00) so the plan is Priya stands at the bottom in enormous waterproofs while Dev and Marcus sprint past her like it's a race 😑 amazing. Simone you're the only reasonable person coming on this trip
[10] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:48:00) December 19th. I fly January 6th. So there's time to do something properly before I go. I'd like that, if everyone's up for it. Something quiet. Not a party, just us.
[11] (about=Dev, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:54:00) Three times a week. Trail running mostly. The canal is just a warmup.
[12] (about=Jonah, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Proposes December 7th for Simone's farewell dinner, a Sunday, giving her two weeks before she flies.
[13] (about=Jonah, core, t1 @2025-10-12T17:45:00) Proposing a November Peak District hike from Edale, a 14km route above Kinder Scout, not too steep with incredible views; asking who's in.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jonah, group-interaction, t9 @2025-11-09T19:30:00) Group decided the Kinder Scout hike weekend was the best Saturday of the year, with 14km, ridge views, log fire, and pints.
[15] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Needs to make a New Year booking by Friday at the latest and asks everyone to confirm their plans.
[16] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Says the Kinder Scout hike weekend was the best Saturday of the year, with 14km, ridge views, log fire, and pints.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Group decided to discuss a city trip in spring in January, not now.
[18] (about=Priya, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Plans to do a bit of scouting for a city trip she's planning on the Sunday of the trail run.
[19] (about=Simone, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) In for the hike assuming she can confirm by end of week; needs exact dates locked down and asks to confirm by Friday at the latest.
[20] (about=Simone, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Last day at the firm is December 19th; flies to Singapore January 6th.
